messages.subject: Login compatibility
messages.body:
Did the gateway change make this window?

The new resolver handles the old compatibility forms at directory lookup. The gateway still checks reserved names after canonical normalization, before the alias gets that far.

I put the last good maintenance capture in /notes/maintenance-frame.txt. It kept the field lengths. The alias wasn’t retained.

- Rowan

messages.subject: RE: Login compatibility
messages.body:
Next window. I was told there was no confirmed unauthorized sign-in.

Keep the capture. I’ll want it in front of me when we review the change.

— Mara
